from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper from the collection, including which other collection papers it cites."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The title of this specific paper")
    references_collection_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER papers in the provided collection that this paper cites in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
